clips.text: Hi, I'm Maria with Alpha Platinum. I can help prepare your vehicle request clearly for our team to review.
clips.instructions: Speak with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: I see you selected a sourcing target example. I will use it as a target specification and help prepare a similar vehicle request.
clips.instructions: Speak with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: Before I prepare the buyer packet, please review the buyer name, destination details, and vehicle request for accuracy.
clips.instructions: Speak with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: Please confirm consent so Alpha Platinum and Rowtronic can follow up about this request. The concierge service fee is separate from vehicle price, shipping, taxes, title, dealer, customs, and export costs.
clips.instructions: Speak with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: Your buyer packet is ready. Use your lead ID as the payment reference, then the Alpha Platinum team can review and follow up.
clips.instructions: Speak with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: Hola, soy Maria de Alpha Platinum. Puedo ayudarte a preparar claramente tu solicitud de vehículo para que nuestro equipo la revise.
clips.instructions: Speak in Spanish with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: Veo que seleccionaste un ejemplo de objetivo de búsqueda. Lo usaré como especificación objetivo y te ayudaré a preparar una solicitud para un vehículo similar.
clips.instructions: Speak in Spanish with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: Antes de preparar el paquete del comprador, por favor revisa el nombre del comprador, los detalles de destino y la solicitud del vehículo para confirmar que todo está correcto.
clips.instructions: Speak in Spanish with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: Por favor confirma tu consentimiento para que Alpha Platinum y Rowtronic puedan dar seguimiento a esta solicitud. La tarifa de servicio concierge es separada del precio del vehículo, envío, impuestos, título, dealer, aduana y costos de exportación.
clips.instructions: Speak in Spanish with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.

clips.text: Tu paquete de comprador está listo. Usa tu Lead ID como referencia de pago, y luego el equipo de Alpha Platinum podrá revisar y dar seguimiento.
clips.instructions: Speak in Spanish with a warm, calm, polished luxury concierge tone. Keep the pace steady and reassuring.
